primary_metrics.title: Rule correctness
primary_metrics.definition: schema, transitions, rule completeness, objectives, terminal

primary_metrics.title: Playable task success
primary_metrics.definition: validated solution or preregistered stochastic threshold, no hard/soft lock

primary_metrics.title: Valid content yield
primary_metrics.definition: valid accepted candidates / all attempted candidates including rejected outputs

primary_metrics.title: Difficulty control error
primary_metrics.definition: absolute measured target deviation, profile and seed protocol fixed

primary_metrics.title: Content diversity
primary_metrics.definition: topology/mechanics/solution features normalized for symmetric equivalents; not file hashes

primary_metrics.title: QA defect detection
primary_metrics.definition: known reproducible defects detected / all injected known defects; also report false positives

primary_metrics.title: Engine fidelity
primary_metrics.definition: state, event, terminal and input parity; visual review separately marked

primary_metrics.title: Human experience measures
primary_metrics.definition: eight separate human ratings; no simulated human or scalar fun score

success_rule: All required task checks PASS with independently produced artifact-bound evidence. Missing checker or missing evidence is NOT_EVALUATED, never a pass.
applicability: Per-task required checks fixed in evaluator/checks.json. Other dimensions report null with reason; never substitute zero.
evaluator_contract: Independent trusted checkers execute artifacts or inspect source and evidence. Model-authored status and usage inside artifact are not evaluator evidence.

retry.feedback: own prior artifact and public checks only; hidden failures not exposed

statistics.paired_effect: within-task treatment minus baseline; descriptive mean and normal-approximation CI, unstable at n<30
statistics.continuous: sample size, mean, median, full distribution and descriptive normal-approximation CI
statistics.multiple_metrics: No post-hoc primary selection; report all applicable primary metrics and avoid population-general causal claims from convenience tasks

release_gate: Formal frozen model A/B and actual exploratory human study required before effectiveness or v1 readiness claims.
manual_aggregation: Every declared automatic and blind-manual obligation is required. Missing evidence never becomes PASS. Deliberate ambiguity/starvation may be correctly resolved as a clarification or infeasibility finding under the exact task rubric, without claiming executable-game success.
difficulty_target_policy: No hidden completion-rate target: targets remain empty where public wording asks diagnosis/comparison, and the task-specific manual rubric assesses supported control/recommendation. Do not compute difficulty_control_error when no numeric target was specified.
